examples.arabic: هو قال مفيش مشكلة وامشي طوالي لحد ما تشوف البنك
examples.english: He said no problem and go straight until you see the bank.
examples.transliteration: Howa aal mafeesh moshkela wa emshy tawaly lahad ma tshouf el bank.

examples.arabic: هو قالي امشي طوالي وبعدين خش يمين
examples.english: He told me to walk straight and then turn right.
examples.transliteration: Howwa 'ali emshi tawali w ba'dein khosh yemin.

examples.arabic: ابتسم الراجل وقالي متقلقش هتوصل بالسلامة امشي طوالي
examples.english: The man smiled and told me, 'Don't worry, you'll arrive safely, walk straight.'
examples.transliteration: Ebtasam el ragel we aly mata'la'sh hatowsal bel salama emshy tawaly

examples.arabic: هو قال لي امشي طوالي وبعدين يمين
examples.english: He told me to walk straight and then right.
examples.transliteration: Howwa 'al li emshi tawali w ba'deen yemeen.
examples.storyTitle: I Got Lost and Asked for Directions

examples.arabic: قال لي امشي طوالي وبعدين خش يمين
examples.english: He told me, "Walk straight and then turn right."
examples.transliteration: Aal li "Emshi tawali w ba'deen khosh yemeen."

examples.english: Go straight ahead, then turn right. Thank you.
examples.transliteration: Emshy tawali w ba'deen yemeen. Shukran.
